support.heading: Keep the archive open
support.message: 21st Memory is free for everyone — no paywalls, no accounts. It is independently built and maintained, and the ongoing costs of hosting, tools, and AI currently exceed what the project can cover on its own. If this archive has been useful, you can help by sharing a topic, inviting others into the community, or contributing toward operating costs — every form of support keeps it available to all.
